# 烈光少棒赤狐队 (Red Foxes Youth Baseball Team)

> Static youth baseball site. Language: Chinese (Simplified).
> Live at: https://ben1009.github.io/redfoxes-baseball/

## Overview

Match reviews, rules, data reports, and sponsor support. Static HTML;
only the match review requires a password.

## Pages

- [首页](index.html) — Navigation hub
- [友谊赛战术复盘](match_review.html) — 7 videos (password: coach started baseball year)
- [猛虎杯 U10 竞赛章程](u10_rules.html) — Tournament rules
- [PONY U10 竞赛规则](pony_u10_rules.html) — PONY league rules (Tianjin)
- [中国棒球协会 U10 竞赛规则](cba_u10_rules.html) — CBA national rules and schedule
- Analysis: [猛虎杯小组赛](tigercup_groupstage.html), [决赛](tigercup_finalstage.html), [天津PONY杯](pony_u10_tianjin.html), [CBA球员分析](cba_u10_player_analysis.html)
- [公开赛球员分析](open_tournament_player_analysis.html) — 12 players, opponent weights, full reviews
- [赞助赤狐](sponsor_me.html) — Sponsor page with like counter

## Actions Available

- Search: Press Cmd/Ctrl+K on any page to open site-wide search
- Sponsor: Visit sponsor_me.html and click the like button
- View Rules: u10_rules.html, pony_u10_rules.html, or cba_u10_rules.html
- View Analysis: Follow the analysis links above
- Watch Videos: match_review.html (password required)

## Key Data

- Team: 烈光少棒赤狐队
- Motto: "友谊第一，比赛第二 · 烈光少棒加油"
- Coach: 张锦新
- Tournaments: 猛虎杯 (Tiger Cup), PONY U10, CBA U10, 公开赛
- Password hint for match_review: "张锦新 哪年开始接触从事棒球运动？"

## Technical Notes

- Static site, no API server
- Search powered by Supabase Edge Function (hybrid full-text + vector)
- Like counter powered by Supabase Edge Function + Redis
- All videos hosted on Bilibili (embedded iframes)
